title: Microsoft Purview: look up permissions by role and membership on the Role groups page
summary: Hold: the summary attributes a no-admin-action statement to a roadmap record that makes no such statement. The scope section also casts doubt on the documented access requirement for the page containing the lookup. The navigation and PowerShell call are supported, but Microsoft pages disagree on which groups hold Role Management.
